label: Kenya minus Kakamega · Jan 12
title: Kenya minus Kakamega: Istanbul, Ol Pejeta, Lake Baringo, Nakuru, Masai Mara and Naivasha
summary: Istanbul 3n, then Ol Pejeta, Lake Baringo & Bogoria, Nakuru, 3 nights in the Masai Mara (2 Naboisho conservancy + a guided National Reserve day), Naivasha and Mount Suswa, without Kakamega. 15 nights on the ground. ~$6,127 pp.
overview:
- **What this is:** the no-crew loop with Kakamega dropped (and with it the Kericho and Narok stopover nights). Every day has a plan; only Dec 31, after the 03:05 landing, is a recovery day.
- **Dates:** LAX Sat Dec 26 → LAX Tue Jan 12. 15 nights on the ground: 3 Istanbul, 12 Kenya (plus 2 on planes).
- **Route:** Istanbul 3n → Nairobi 1n → Ol Pejeta 2n → **Lake Baringo 2n** → Nakuru 1n → **Masai Mara 3n** (Naboisho conservancy 2n + a reserve-edge camp after a guided National Reserve day) → Naivasha 2n → Mount Suswa on the way to an airport hotel 1n.
- **Masai Mara, both sides:** the conservancy for the walk, night drive and off-road driving with a vehicle cap; the National Reserve with your own guide for the big open plains and the Mara River.
- **After dark and on foot:** night drives at Ol Pejeta and in the Mara; walks at Ol Pejeta, the Mara conservancy, Crescent Island, Hell's Gate gorge and the Mount Suswa caves.
- **No empty travel days:** Jan 5 reaches Nakuru by 10:00 for a full park day; the last day is Mount Suswa on the way to the airport.
- **Budget: ~$6,127 pp**. Biggest items after the Mara camp: the reserve day (fee, guide, camp ~$360), the private car to Baringo ($110) and the Suswa 4x4 day ($120).

itinerary.title: Fly toward Istanbul
itinerary.details: TK10 LAX 19:45 → IST 19:00 next day (~13h). Start shifting to Istanbul time on board.

itinerary.title: Land Istanbul, metro into the city
itinerary.details: Land 19:00. Metro M11 → M2 → T1 to Sultanahmet, ~1.5h door to door, ~₺80–150. Buy an Istanbulkart at the station. Easy dinner, early night.

itinerary.title: Sultanahmet on foot
itinerary.details: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, the Basilica Cistern — all within ten minutes of each other. Zero travel.

itinerary.title: Topkapı, Grand Bazaar, Bosphorus
itinerary.details: Topkapı in the morning, Grand Bazaar after lunch, then a public ferry to Kadıköy on the Asian side for dinner. The ferry is the best view in the city and costs almost nothing.

itinerary.title: Free morning, fly to Nairobi
itinerary.details: Spice Bazaar, Süleymaniye or the Archaeological Museum. Bags at the hotel. Leave for the airport by 17:00. TK607 20:30 → NBO 03:05.

itinerary.title: Land 03:05, full rest day
itinerary.details: Pre-booked taxi to the guesthouse, ~45m. Room held from Dec 30 so it's ready at 04:00. Sleep to ~11:00, then stay in daylight and no naps after 15:00. Buy a Safaricom SIM. Quiet New Year's Eve.

itinerary.title: North to Ol Pejeta, first night drive
itinerary.details: Matatu Nairobi → Nanyuki via Thika and Karatina, ~3.5–4.5h with filling time, KSh 700–1,000. Prefer a registered shuttle company over a street matatu. Transfer to the conservancy ~45m. Afternoon at The Stables. 19:00 shared night game drive (~2h, spotlight): lions and hyena on the move, plus a chance of aardwolf, bat-eared fox, porcupine and genet. The hired vehicle is booked for tomorrow. Public holiday: start early, fewer vehicles run.

itinerary.title: Bush walk at 06:30, then a full day of rhino
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Guided bush walk 06:30 ($70, max 6). Then a full 8h day in the hired OPC vehicle (The Stables has no vehicles): black and white rhino, Sweetwaters chimps, lion, Grevy's zebra. The last two northern white rhinos (Najin and Fatu) are a separately booked visit, not a drive-by.

itinerary.title: Thomson's Falls and down into the Rift
itinerary.details: Private car from Ol Pejeta via Nyahururu (30-min stop at Thomson's Falls), then down the escarpment to Lake Baringo, ~4.5h with the stop. Arrive for a late lunch. Late afternoon: guided walk along the cliffs behind Kampi ya Samaki with a local bird guide — Baringo has one of Kenya's longest bird lists.

itinerary.title: Dawn boat on Baringo, geysers at Bogoria
itinerary.details: 06:30 boat on the lake (~2h): fish eagles diving for thrown fish, Nile crocodiles, hippo pods, Goliath herons. Late morning taxi to Lake Bogoria (~1h): geysers and boiling hot springs on the shore, flamingos when the water suits them, and a chance of greater kudu along the western shore. Back to Baringo by dusk.

itinerary.title: Early to Nakuru, full afternoon in the park
itinerary.details: 06:30 matatu Kampi ya Samaki → Marigat → Nakuru (~2.5h). Hired vehicle with driver from the hotel at ~10:00 (book by phone the day before), in the park until the 18:30 close: white rhino near-certain, black rhino a good chance, Rothschild's giraffe, flamingos if the lake allows. Entry $90 on eCitizen (cashless).

itinerary.title: Over the Mau to the Masai Mara
itinerary.details: Early matatu Nakuru → Narok (~2.5h). The camp collects you at Narok around midday (~2.5h). Lunch in camp, afternoon drive; ask for the night drive tonight so tomorrow is free for the full day.

itinerary.title: Walking safari, full day out, night drive
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Guided walking safari at dawn (allowed in conservancies, banned in the National Reserve), then out all day with a packed lunch: big cats, topi, plains game, off-road with a vehicle cap. Night drive for serval, genet, porcupine if not done last night. Confirm walk and night drive are included in writing.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara National Reserve with a private guide
itinerary.details: 06:00 pickup at camp by a licensed Mara guide in a pop-top vehicle; ~45m to Talek gate. Full day in the National Reserve with a packed lunch: the open plains for lion and cheetah, the Mara River (hippo pods, big crocodiles, the migration crossing points, empty of herds in January) and the Talek river woodland for leopard. No off-road driving in the reserve, and popular sightings can draw a crowd. The reserve closes at 18:30; the guide drops you at a budget camp near Talek.

itinerary.title: Back up the Rift to Naivasha
itinerary.details: Camp vehicle Talek → Narok (~2.5h), then matatu via Mai Mahiu to Naivasha (~2.5–3h, maybe a change at Mai Mahiu). ~5.5h door to door. Lakeshore camp by mid-afternoon; hippos on the lawn after dark.

itinerary.title: Hell's Gate at dawn, Crescent Island in the afternoon
itinerary.details: At Elsa Gate for the 06:00 opening, when zebra, buffalo, eland and giraffe are out on the road. Cycle ~7 km past Fischer's Tower to Ol Njorowa gorge, then the Lower Gorge with a licensed guide: a scramble down a narrow red canyon past hot springs and steam vents. Out by ~12:00. Afternoon boat on the lake (hippos, fish eagles) to Crescent Island: walk freely among zebra, giraffe, waterbuck and wildebeest.

itinerary.title: Mount Suswa, then on to the airport
itinerary.details: Hired 4x4 with driver from Naivasha at 06:30 with your bags, via Mai Mahiu and a rough track up the volcano (~2–2.5h). Hike to the outer crater rim with a community guide (~2.5h round trip), then a guided walk into the lava-tube caves (~1.5h; bats, collapsed skylights; bring a headtorch). Then ~2–2.5h to a hotel near JKIA by ~17:30. Shower, repack, early night.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.details: Hotel shuttle 03:00. TK608 NBO 04:50 → IST, then TK9 → LAX, arriving ~18:15 the same day. About 25h door to door.

lodging.name: Istanbul hotel (TK Stopover, 2 nights free)
lodging.includes: Room and breakfast. Turkish Airlines gives US-origin economy passengers two free nights, once per ticket — only the third is paid.
lodging.why: Breaks the 1.5h Istanbul connection risk and splits the +11h time shift into two moves.
lodging.alternatives: Pay for all three nights and choose your own hotel and neighbourhood, about +$180 pp.

lodging.name: Budget guesthouse, Karen or Langata
lodging.includes: ~$60/room. Hold the room from Dec 30 so it's ready at 04:00.
lodging.why: A 03:05 landing needs a bed already paid for, not a check-in queue.
lodging.alternatives: Airport-area hotel if you'd rather not cross the city at 04:00.

lodging.name: The Stables, Ol Pejeta
lodging.includes: Full board ($140/double). No game-drive vehicles: hire an OPC vehicle with driver. Entry $110 per 24h separate.
lodging.why: Cheapest bed inside OPC, and meals included.

options.name: The Stables, Ol Pejeta
options.why: Cheapest bed inside OPC; meals included.
options.notes: No vehicles; hire OPC car with driver.

options.name: Pelican House (self-catering)
options.includes: Kitchen; bring food (+~$15 pp/day vs Stables FB, netted in)
options.why: Lake view, more space; cook yourselves.

lodging.name: Lakeside banda, Kampi ya Samaki (e.g. Roberts Camp)
lodging.includes: ~$50/banda, room only; restaurant or self-catering. Estimate — confirm with the camp.
lodging.why: On the lakeshore where the boats leave; hippos graze the lawns at night.
lodging.alternatives: Island Camp on Ol Kokwe island is the upmarket choice.

lodging.name: Budget hotel, Nakuru town
lodging.includes: Room only. Both Main and Lanet gates are minutes away.
lodging.why: Staying in town rather than the KWS campsite means one park day instead of two, saves $90, and needs no camping gear.
lodging.alternatives: KWS public campsite inside the park at $30 pppn, if you carry a tent.

lodging.name: Basecamp Wilderness, Naboisho (Masai Mara)
lodging.includes: Full board ~$500 + Naboisho conservation fee ~$130 pppn. Shared drives, guided walks and night drives are conservancy activities; confirm each is in the rate.
lodging.why: A real conservancy stay: walks, night drives and off-road with a vehicle cap, and better wildlife density than Siana.

options.name: Basecamp Wilderness, Naboisho (Masai Mara)
options.includes: FB + conservation fee; drives, walks, night drives (confirm)
options.notes: Jan 2026 agent rate; confirm Jan 2027 in writing.

options.name: Enkorok Mara Camp (Siana area)
options.includes: FB ~$145 + Mara Reserve fee $100/day (Jan–Jun rate) + shared reserve drives ~$75
options.why: Half the price; walks and night drives depend on whether drives stay in the conservancy.
options.notes: Sources conflict: some place it inside Siana Conservancy, others just outside the reserve. Ask whether drives stay in the conservancy or go into the National Reserve, where walks and night drives are banned.

lodging.name: Budget tented camp near Talek (e.g. Enkorok Mara Camp)
lodging.location: Talek, Masai Mara National Reserve edge
lodging.includes: Full board ~$145 pp. Permanent tents with beds and bathrooms. Reserve fee and the guided day are separate lines.
lodging.why: Ends the reserve day at the gate it leaves from, instead of paying another conservancy night.
lodging.alternatives: A third night back at Basecamp Wilderness is about +$485 pp (conservancy fee included).

lodging.name: Camp Carnelley's or Fisherman's Camp
lodging.includes: Banda with a restaurant and bar on site, so no cooking.
lodging.why: Hippos graze the lawns after dark, and Hell's Gate needs no vehicle.
lodging.alternatives: Campsite pitch is cheaper if you carry a tent.

lodging.name: Budget hotel near JKIA (free shuttle)
lodging.includes: ~$80/room B&B, free airport shuttle, 10–20 minutes from the terminal.
lodging.why: A 04:50 departure means no 01:30 cross-city pickup.

practical:
## Entry
- Kenya eTA $30, **etakenya.go.ke only** (not etas.gov.ke); lookalike sites overcharge. Passport 6+ months, 2 blank pages.
- Türkiye is visa-free for US tourists.

## Packing
- **No camping gear needed.** Every night is a room, a banda (cabin) or the Mara's permanent tented camp, which has real beds and an en-suite bathroom.
- **One bag each you can carry and lift onto a roof rack.** About seven matatu legs; no wheeled cases.
- Ventilated low hikers plus **short gaiters** for grass seeds on the Ol Pejeta and Mara walks.
- Headtorch and a power bank.
- A fleece. Laikipia and Nakuru nights run 8–12°C and dawn drives are genuinely cold. Istanbul is 4–9°C and wet.
- **No camouflage or military-style clothing**: wearing anything resembling police/military uniform is illegal and police enforce it. Plastic bags are banned, including ones brought in (duty-free bags get confiscated).

## Money
- ~130 KES to the dollar. **Carry both cash and cards.** All KWS payments are cashless through eCitizen; matatus, bodas, bike hire and tips are cash only.
- Safaricom SIM at the airport with your passport, then set up M-Pesa.
- Crisp post-2013 USD bills for tips.

## Fees
- The October 2025 KWS increase is still in court, but **the new rates are being charged**: Nakuru $90, Hell's Gate $50 (+~$10 cycling). Lake Bogoria is a county reserve ($50), not KWS.
- Ol Pejeta and the Mara conservancies are not KWS and run separate, cashless systems.
- Ol Pejeta entry covers 24h for overnight guests, but day visitors pay again on re-entry.

## Road reality
- **Nothing moves after dark.** Rural matatus stop in the late afternoon. Every leg is built for a morning start.
- Longest days are Jan 9 (~5.5h) and the Suswa day (Jan 11). Baringo is hot (30–35°C at midday): boats at dawn, walks early or late.
- Jan 1 is a public holiday — matatus run fuller and less often.

## Health and safety
- Kenya is **Level 2** (reissued Jul 2026). No Do-Not-Travel areas on this route.
- **Matatus:** the State Dept tells travelers to avoid matatus and boda-bodas, and US government staff may not use them. The main risk is **crashes**, not just theft. Prefer registered coach/shuttle companies, daylight only, and get your insurer to confirm in writing that matatu and boda travel is covered.
- **Yellow fever:** not required for US arrivals, but **CDC-recommended** for this route (everything outside Nairobi city and the coast).
- **Ebola:** Kenya confirmed an imported Bundibugyo case on Oct 6 2026 (patient from DRC via Kampala, died in Nairobi). Nakuru was named a high-risk preparedness county. Re-check the advisory before paying deposits; prefer refundable bookings.
- **Mpox:** active in Nakuru and Nairobi.
- Malaria prophylaxis from before arrival through 7 days after. DEET.
- AMREF Maisha Bronze ($10) covers 15 days: start it Dec 31; it covers the whole Kenya stay.

fatigue_check:
Longest days: Jan 9 (~5.5h, Talek → Narok → Naivasha) and Jan 11 (Suswa hike and caves between two ~2h drives, ~8h out).
Jan 6 (Nakuru → Narok → Masai Mara) is ~5h; Jan 3 is ~4.5h in a private car with the Thomson's Falls stop.
Busy stretch: Jan 6–11, with no rest day between the Mara and the flight. Dec 31 is the only recovery day.
